primitive.relation: a class F of finite simple graphs is polynomially chi-bounded in LIST form: one natural coefficient list p (lowest degree first), chosen before the graphs, bounds the chromatic number of every member by GTBase.poly_nat.horner_nat p evaluated at its clique number. X3's x3_polynomially_chi_bounded (used by X65 and X66's x66_good) and X124's x124_poly_chi_bounded (whose x124_omega G := omega([set: G])) are transparent aliases, each related to its frozen original by a CONVERSION (A31's evaluator aliases unfold to the canonical evaluator), so every row using them is equivalent in every polarity, X3's negated class included. No guard: the empty list bounds exactly chromatic number zero. Over the naturals it is equivalent to the normal form poly_chi_bounded (c * omega ^ d) by Chromatic.foundations.poly_forms.poly_chi_bounded_x3E (the omega = 0 corner included), which stays a distinct encoding.

list-form-poly-chi-bound.note: one coefficient list quantified before the graphs, natural Horner evaluation at the clique number; conversions to the owner's body

distinct_variants.Chromatic.foundations.chi_bounding.poly_: the normal form c * omega ^ d (P-normal), owned by the same module and used by X218: equivalent over the naturals (poly_forms.poly_chi_bounded_x3E, omega = 0 corner included) but a distinct encoding with its own consumers; not merged.
distinct_variants.Chromatic.foundations.chi_bounding.chi_b: an arbitrary bounding function of the clique number (family chi-bounded); strictly weaker (poly_list_chi_boundedW).
